facts.business: NSDL is India's first and leading depository, providing depository services including dematerialisation, re-materialisation, holding, transfer and pledge of securities in electronic form, e-voting services, and straight-through processing for market intermediaries.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital contracts not provided for (net of advances)

key_risks: Legal proceedings related to Karvy pledge matter pending before Supreme Court with potential financial obligations
Other legal proceedings filed by beneficial owners/third parties in normal course of business
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include IDBI Bank Limited, National Stock Exchange of India Limited (both substantial interest/shareholders >10%), wholly-owned subsidiary NSDL Database Management Limited, subsidiary NSDL Payments Bank Limited, associate India International Bullion Holding IFSC Limited, and companies in which directors are interested (GKM Global Services Private Limited, Acer Credit Rating Private Limited). Key management personnel include Managing Director & CEO Vijay Chandok and other directors.
